verses.text: After Moses, the servant of the LORD, died, the LORD spoke to Joshua son of Nun, who had been Moses' helper.
He said, "My servant Moses is dead. So now get up. Cross the Jordan River, you and all these people, into the land I am giving to the people of Israel.
I have given you every place where you put your foot, just as I promised Moses.
Your land will stretch from the desert and Lebanon to the great Euphrates River, all the land of the Hittites, and west to the Great Sea.
No one will be able to stand against you all your life. I will be with you just as I was with Moses. I will never leave you or give up on you.
Be strong and brave, because you will lead these people to take the land I promised their ancestors.
Only be strong and very brave. Be careful to obey all the law my servant Moses gave you. Do not turn from it to the right or to the left, so that you will do well wherever you go.
Keep this book of the law always on your lips. Think about it day and night, so that you will be careful to do everything written in it. Then you will do well and succeed.
Have I not commanded you? Be strong and brave. Do not be afraid, and do not lose heart, because the LORD your God is with you wherever you go."
Then Joshua gave orders to the leaders of the people.
He said, "Go through the camp and tell the people, 'Get food ready. In three days you will cross the Jordan to go in and take the land the LORD your God is giving you.'"
Joshua also spoke to the tribes of Reuben and Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
He said, "Remember what Moses, the servant of the LORD, told you: 'The LORD your God is giving you rest, and he will give you this land.'

Your wives, your children and your animals may stay in the land Moses gave you east of the Jordan. But all your strong fighting men must cross over ahead of your brothers, armed and ready, and help them,

until the LORD gives them rest as he has given you, and they also take the land the LORD your God is giving them. After that you may go back to your own land east of the Jordan, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you."
They answered Joshua, "We will do everything you have told us, and we will go wherever you send us.
We obeyed Moses in everything, and we will obey you too. Only may the LORD your God be with you as he was with Moses.
Anyone who rebels against your order and does not obey your words will be put to death. Only be strong and brave!"
